title: [Permissions] Fix read-only error in obsolete permission cleanup
summary: The Remove Obsolete Permissions action now deletes only from the Tenant Permission table instead of the read-only system Permission table, ensuring cleanup works correctly on SaaS infrastructure.
key_points: Cleanup is now tenant-only, affecting both user-defined and extension-owned permission sets
System permissions remain untouched on all environments
Action no longer attempts to modify the read-only Permission table on SaaS
Tooltip and result messages updated to reflect tenant scope
Tests updated to write only to tenant permissions
